generationRules.statusRule: Every visual instruction carries a sourceFieldPath, status, and sourceIds entry.
generationRules.blockedRule: Blocked fields may create labeled caution instructions but must not be promoted to exact visual claims.

style.text: Preserve Inked Indie / Compact Corner: crisp isometric map readability, confident inked outlines, controlled hatching, warm compact storefront massing, integrated paper/card visual language if UI is included.

visualInstructions.text: Render only the NW Grillpoint corner as a one-corner reproduction slice within Manhattan Ave x Greenpoint Ave context.
Use the review-only visible label 'Grillpoint Deli' for the deli sign/card identity, without ratings, reviews, hours, quality, or promotional claims.
Represent the place as a deli / food retail storefront through neutral visual cues only.
Keep the storefront within the current NW scene envelope so it can be compared directly against the MVP-29E raster crop.
Use one estimated storefront-facing segment as an approximate review-scale frontage guide; do not imply exact tenant frontage or storefront order.
Compose a compact three-bay deli rhythm: sign band above, storefront/window texture below, one entry cue, and enough sidewalk edge to read as a corner.
Use a dark sign band with review-only Grillpoint Deli text; stylize rather than trace the real sign, logo, material, or trade dress.
Show a single storefront entry cue with compact window rhythm, labeled internally as approximate/manual draft.
Use warm compact corner massing, dark sign band contrast, restrained deli-window density, and Greenpoint street-level texture without hiding click targets.
A Greenpoint G/subway railing cue may appear as nearby symbolic context only; avoid any exact entrance-coordinate or in-front-of-Grillpoint claim.

deterministicPrompt: Review-only one-corner raster generation spec for the NW Grillpoint Deli corner at Manhattan Ave x Greenpoint Ave.

Preserve the approved Inked Indie / Compact Corner direction from ARC-023, ARC-024, and ARC-029: crisp isometric map readability, confident inked outlines, controlled hatching, compact storefront massing, and paper/card UI compatibility.
Render only the NW Grillpoint corner as a compact isometric deli storefront slice that can be compared directly to the MVP-29E NW crop.

Use the review-only identity 'Grillpoint Deli' and neutral deli / food retail cues. Do not include ratings, reviews, hours, service claims, quality claims, promotional claims, or endorsement language.

Use a dark sign band with stylized readable Grillpoint Deli text, a three-bay review-scale storefront rhythm, one approximate entry cue, compact windows, warm corner massing, and restrained Greenpoint sidewalk clutter.

A Greenpoint G/subway railing cue may appear only as nearby symbolic transit context. Do not imply exact station geometry, exact entrance coordinates, or that the entrance is directly in front of Grillpoint.
Do not trace, texture-extract, reproduce exact trade dress, or claim exact facade/frontage/address placement. Output is non-production and review-only.
comparisonQuestions: Does the spec preserve Grillpoint identity/category/address context without overclaiming exact facade/frontage/station geometry?
Can each visual instruction be traced to a structured source field and status?
Does the resulting instruction set reveal which fields are sourced, inferred, manual_draft, symbolic, blocked, or unresolved before four-corner regeneration?
